summary: HCW Biologics filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its Special Meeting due to lack of quorum, with no business conducted. The two proposals will be resubmitted at the Annual Meeting on June 15, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is described. This is a routine procedural update regarding stockholder meeting logistics and proxy solicitation. The filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
